analyst_view.overall: Early view: a bottom-of-the-table game between Ceuta (22nd, 5 points, five straight defeats) and Albacete (21st), who have won three in a row under Joseba Etxeberria. Corpas should be back for Albacete after his three-match ban, and a win for either side would matter a lot in the relegation fight.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Ceuta's home games average about 2.6 and Albacete's away games three, but relegation six-pointers are often tense, so I stay with the site's number.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners. Ceuta won five corners even in a 3-0 defeat at Córdoba and should push at home, while Albacete prefer quick transitions; I see no clear reason to move.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards. I lean higher: Albacete picked up six yellows at Leganés with Etxeberria's pressing, Ceuta's Carlos Hernández is on four yellows, and a game between the bottom two should be fiercely contested.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.4 shots, with 19 for Ceuta. I lean lower: Ceuta took 12 shots at Córdoba and have scored only six goals at home, and Albacete took 12 in their win at Leganés.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. I lean slightly lower in line with the lower shot count, although Albacete have been efficient (five on target from 12 at Leganés).
